newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH '96 NEW CAR REGISTRATIONS UP 20 PCT - CENTRE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH '96 NEW CAR REGISTRATIONS UP 20 PCT - CENTRE.

text.p: Registrations of new private cars in Finland rose by 20.0 percent year-on-year in 1996 to over 95,000, the Vehicle Administration Centre said in a statement received on Friday.
The figure is in line with the full-year 1996 new private car sales target set by the the car dealers' automobile branch.
New private car registrations rose steadily during the 1980s and peaked at 176,800 cars in 1989, the centre said.
Then car registrations fell to 55,800 cars in 1993, but started to rise again in 1994, it said.
